title: Science PCMB
intro: Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology. This keeps both medicine and engineering open.

nodes.label: Choose PCMB
nodes.note: You study all four subjects. This keeps both medicine and engineering open.

nodes.label: Boards and entrance prep
nodes.note: In Karnataka this is the 2-year PUC. Keep up your board marks as well as exam prep.

nodes.label: B.Pharm
